title: Agent Runtime YAML Frontmatter Key Dictionary v1
note: Single source for the frontmatter key vocabulary. The guidelines module owns why each key exists; this file owns which keys exist, which tier they belong to, and whether a checker gates them. Neither the validator nor any prose table may restate this data.

enforcementLevels.required: A checker gates this key. Absent from a triggered tier, it raises the key's finding and exits non-zero.
enforcementLevels.recommended: Documented and reserved, not yet gated. Recorded here so prose cannot promise enforcement that no checker performs. Promotion to required is a ratchet step with its own baseline.

tiers.name: Identity
tiers.trigger: Always bound; identity is not conditional

tiers.name: Address
tiers.appliesTo: Every artifact a machine resolves, digests, or pins
tiers.trigger: Any addressTriggerKey is present, or the artifact claims readiness

tiers.name: Accountability
tiers.appliesTo: Every artifact whose state gates work

tiers.name: Evidence
tiers.appliesTo: Every artifact claiming any readiness above draft
tiers.trigger: A localRungKey names a rung outside unprovenRungs

tiers.name: Boundary
tiers.appliesTo: Every artifact whose subject can reach a delivered surface
tiers.trigger: Authored declaration only; reaching a delivered surface is not derivable from frontmatter alone

keys.contract: Human-readable subject; never a file path.
Artifact class from the corpus vocabulary.
required where these rules bind; optional only for an explicitly exempt class.
<slug>/v<major>, stable while the artifact's contract is unchanged. Its stem matches graphId where both exist.
md:<slug> stable address. Required where a graph, canvas, or index resolves the artifact by identity.
Semantic version of this artifact, advanced on every substantive change. Policy digests pin it, so a stale version invalidates every digest that bound it.
The function accountable for the artifact, named by role, never by person or vendor.
Readiness of this artifact in its own lane.
Readiness at the delivered surface. Never equal to local_rung by default and never omitted when local_rung is set; a single conflated status is the defect this pair exists to prevent.
Where a corpus already requires it, status is local_rung and carries no other meaning. Declaring both requires them to agree.
Current lane; the Deploy Boundary reads it and never infers it.
fail-closed unless an explicit, versioned, auditable exception names its alternate boundary.

Pointer to the recorded evidence: test path, receipt, or proof ledger. Canonical spelling; proof is a permitted short form only where a declared byte budget makes the canonical key infeasible, and the artifact declares that budget.
The exactly-invocable mechanism that judges this artifact, distinct from whoever authored it.
Exactly what the artifact governs, bounded.
Exactly what it asserts and, explicitly, what it does not.
The authority ceiling, stated as what is not granted.

date.description: ISO calendar date, no time and no zone

forbiddenValuePatterns.reason: Frontmatter is world-readable and digest-pinned; a credential here cannot be revoked by rewriting history
